paragraphs: IAC today is comprised of category leading businesses, including People Inc. and Care.com, among others, and holds strategic equity positions in MGM Resorts International and Turo Inc.
As used herein, "IAC," the "Company," "we," "our," "us" and other similar terms refer to IAC Inc. and its subsidiaries (unless the context requires otherwise).

IAC began as a hybrid media/electronic retailing company over twenty-five years ago. Since then, IAC (directly and through predecessor entities) has transformed itself into a leading Internet company through the development, building, acquisition and distribution to its stockholders of a number of businesses and continues to build companies and invest opportunistically.

From and after the late 1990s, we acquired a number of e-commerce companies, including Ticketmaster Group (later renamed Ticketmaster), Hotel Reservations Network (later renamed Hotels.com), Expedia.com, Match.com, LendingTree (later renamed Tree.com, Inc.), TripAdvisor, HomeAdvisor and Ask Jeeves, as well as Interval International (later renamed Interval Leisure Group, Inc.).

In 2005, we completed the separation of our travel and travel-related businesses and investments into an independent public company, Expedia, Inc. (now known as Expedia Group, Inc.). In 2008, we separated into five independent public companies: IAC (then IAC/InterActiveCorp), HSN, Inc. (now part of Qurate Retail, Inc.), Interval Leisure Group, Inc. (now part of Marriott Vacations Worldwide Corporation), Ticketmaster (now known as Live Nation Entertainment, Inc.) and Tree.com, Inc. (now known as LendingTree, Inc.). Following this transaction, we continued to invest in and acquire e-commerce companies, including About.com (later renamed Dotdash) and a number of online dating companies in the United States and various jurisdictions abroad.

In 2017, we completed the combination of the businesses in our former HomeAdvisor financial reporting segment with those of Angie's List, Inc. under a new public company, ANGI Homeservices Inc. (now known as Angi Inc.), that we control. And in 2018, through this entity we acquired Handy Technologies, Inc., a leading platform in the United States for connecting consumers looking for household services with top-quality, pre-screened independent home professionals.

In February 2020, we acquired Care.com, a leading online destination for families to connect with caregivers for their children, aged parents, pets and homes, and for caregivers to connect with families seeking care services. In June 2020, we completed the separation of our online dating businesses into an independent public company, Match Group, Inc.

In May 2021, we completed the spin-off of our full stake in our Vimeo business, after which Vimeo, Inc. (formerly Vimeo Holdings, Inc. ("Vimeo")) became an independent public company. In December 2021, through Dotdash Media Inc., we completed the acquisition of Meredith Holdings Corp., owner of a portfolio of publishing brands. Following this acquisition, we refer to the combined entity, which operates the brands and businesses of our former Dotdash financial reporting segment and those of Meredith Holdings Corp., as Dotdash Meredith Inc. ("Dotdash Meredith").

In November 2022, we completed the sale of Bluecrew, a technology driven staffing platform exclusively for flexible W-2 work. On February 15, 2024, we completed the sale of assets of Mosaic Group, a leading developer and provider of global subscription mobile applications, for approximately $160 million.

On March 31, 2025, IAC completed the spin-off of Angi Inc. ("Angi") by means of a special dividend (the "Distribution") of all shares of Angi capital stock held by IAC to holders of its common stock and Class B common stock. As a result of the Distribution, IAC no longer owns any shares of Angi's capital stock and Angi became an independent public company.

Lastly, we hold meaningful minority stakes in MGM Resorts International, a leader in gaming, hospitality and leisure, and Turo Inc., a car sharing marketplace, as well as a controlling interest in Vivian Health, a platform to efficiently connect healthcare professionals with job opportunities.

IAC has outstanding shares of common stock, with one vote per share, and shares of Class B common stock, with ten votes per share and which are convertible into shares of common stock on a one-for-one basis. As of the date of this report, Barry Diller, IAC's Chairman and Senior Executive, his spouse (Diane von Furstenberg) and his stepson (Alexander von Furstenberg), collectively hold (directly and through certain trusts) 5,789,499 shares of Class B common stock, representing 100% of the outstanding shares of Class B common stock. Together with shares of common stock held as of the date of this report by Mr. Diller (665,534), Mr. von Furstenberg (81,348), a trust for the benefit of certain members of Mr. Diller's family (136,711) and a family foundation (1,711), these holdings collectively represent approximately 46% of the total outstanding voting power of IAC (based on the number of shares of IAC common and Class B common stock outstanding on February 2, 2026).

Pursuant to an amended and restated governance agreement between IAC and Mr. Diller, for so long as Mr. Diller serves as IAC's Chairman and Senior Executive and he beneficially owns (within the meaning of Rule 13d-3 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended) at least 5,000,000 shares of Class B common stock and/or common stock in which he has a pecuniary interest (including IAC securities beneficially owned by him directly and indirectly through trusts for the benefit of certain members of his family), he generally has the right to consent to certain limited matters specified in the governance agreement in the event that IAC's ratio of total debt to EBITDA (as defined in the governance agreement) equals or exceeds four to one over a continuous twelve-month period.

As a result of the IAC securities held by Mr. Diller and certain members of his family, Mr. Diller and these family members are, collectively, as of the date of this report, in a position to influence (subject to IAC's organizational documents and Delaware law) the composition of IAC's board of directors and the outcome of corporate actions requiring stockholder approval (such as mergers, business combinations and dispositions of assets, among other corporate transactions).

headings: Risk Factors Related to Our Business, Operations and Ownership
Marketing efforts designed to drive visitors to our various brands and businesses may not be successful or cost-effective.

Advertising revenue represents a significant portion of our consolidated revenue. Accordingly, we are sensitive to general economic events and trends that adversely impact advertising spending levels.
Our success depends, in part, on the ability of our Digital business to successfully expand the audience of its portfolio of publishing brands.
Certain of our businesses depend upon arrangements with Google.
Our success depends, in part, on our ability to access, collect and use personal data about our users and subscribers.
Our Print business is experiencing ongoing revenue decline and faces structural, cost, and operational challenges that could adversely affect our results of operations.
Our pension plan obligations could increase.
Our success depends, in part, on the ability of Care.com to establish and maintain relationships with quality and trustworthy caregivers.
Our ability to engage directly with our subscribers and caregivers on a timely basis is critical to our success.
Mr. Diller and certain members of his family are able to exercise significant influence over the composition of IAC's board of directors, matters subject to stockholder approval and IAC's operations.
Risk Factors Related to Our Liquidity, Indebtedness and Dilution
Current and future indebtedness could affect our ability to operate our business, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.
We may not be able to generate sufficient cash to service all of our indebtedness.
Variable rate indebtedness and interest rate swaps subject us to interest rate risk and counterparty risk, respectively.
We may not be able to freely access the cash of People Inc. and its subsidiaries.
You may experience dilution with respect to your investment in IAC as a result of compensatory equity awards.
The market price and trading volume of IAC common stock may be volatile, and investors may experience losses.
If securities or industry analysts do not continue to publish research or publish unfavorable research about IAC, the market price and trading volume of IAC common stock could decline.
IAC and Angi may not realize the anticipated benefits of the Distribution.
Following the Distribution, IAC operates as a smaller, less diversified company.

If the Distribution fails to qualify as a transaction that is generally tax-free for U.S. federal income tax purposes, IAC, Angi and their respective stockholders could suffer material adverse consequences.
IAC or Angi may fail to perform their obligations pursuant to certain agreements between them.
Our businesses operate in especially competitive and evolving industries.

As used herein, "IAC," the "Company," "we," "our" or "us" and similar terms refer to IAC Inc. and its subsidiaries (unless the context requires otherwise).

On March 31, 2025, IAC completed the spin-off of Angi Inc. ("Angi") by means of a special dividend (the "Distribution") of all shares of Angi capital stock held by IAC to holders of its common stock and Class B common stock. Following the Distribution, IAC no longer owns any shares of Angi's capital stock and Angi became an independent public company. As a result of the Distribution, the consolidated operations of Angi are presented as discontinued operations within IAC's consolidated financial statements for all periods prior to March 31, 2025. See "Note 17—Discontinued Operations" in the accompanying notes to the financial statements included in "Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data" for additional information.

Unless otherwise indicated or as the context otherwise requires, certain terms used in this annual report, which include the principal operating metrics we use in managing our business, are defined below.

•People Inc. - one of the largest digital and print publishers in America and is committed to content—made by people for people—that delights, teaches, inspires and entertains. More than 175 million people trust People Inc. each month to help them make decisions, take action, and find inspiration. People Inc.'s over 40 iconic brands include PEOPLE, Better Homes & Gardens, Verywell, Food & Wine, Travel + Leisure, Allrecipes, REAL SIMPLE, Investopedia, and Southern Living. People Inc. has two operating segments: (i) Digital, which includes its digital, mobile and licensing operations; and (ii) Print, which includes its magazine subscription and newsstand operations.

On July 31, 2025, Dotdash Meredith Inc. was rebranded "People Inc." and is referred to as such throughout this report (unless the context requires otherwise). Dotdash Meredith Inc. remains the entity's legal name;

•Care.com, a leading online destination for families to connect with caregivers for their children, aged parents, pets and homes and for caregivers to connect with families seeking care services. Care.com's brands include Care for Business, Care.com's offerings to enterprises, and HomePay;

•Search - consists of Ask Media Group, a collection of websites providing general search services and information, and Desktop, our legacy desktop search software business, which includes our business-to-business partnership operations and the remaining installed base of our direct-to-consumer downloadable desktop applications; and

◦Mosaic Group, a former developer and provider of global subscription mobile applications, for periods prior to the sale of its assets on February 15, 2024, which was accounted for as a sale of a business, for approximately $160 million.
For a more complete description of the Company's operating businesses, see "Description of IAC Businesses" included in "Item 1—Business."
•Digital Revenue - includes advertising revenue, performance marketing revenue and licensing and other revenue.

◦Advertising revenue - primarily includes revenue generated from digital advertisements and intent-based advertising targeting capabilities (D/Cipher+), which are sold directly to advertisers or through advertising agencies and programmatic advertising networks.

◦Performance marketing revenue - primarily includes commissions generated through affiliate commerce, performance marketing services and affinity marketing channels. Affiliate commerce commission revenue is generated when People Inc.'s branded content refers consumers to commerce partner websites resulting in a purchase or transaction. Performance marketing services commission revenue is generated on a cost-per-click or cost-per-action basis. Affinity marketing programs are arrangements where People Inc. acts as an agent for both People Inc. and third-party publishers to market and place magazine subscriptions online for which commission revenue is earned when a subscriber name has been provided to the publisher.

◦Licensing and Other revenue - primarily includes revenue generated through brand and content licensing and similar agreements. Brand licensing generates royalties from long-term trademark licensing agreements with retailers, service providers, publishers and manufacturers. Content licensing royalties are earned from our relationship with Apple News+ as well as other content use and distribution relationships, including utilization in large-language models and other artificial intelligence ("AI") related activities.

paragraphs: IAC 現在由多個領導產業的業務組成，包括 People Inc. 和 Care.com 等，並持有 MGM Resorts International 和 Turo Inc. 的戰略股權。
herein 所稱的 "IAC"、"本公司"、"我們"、"我們的"、"我們" 及其他類似詞語，均指 IAC Inc. 及其子公司（除非上下文另有明確要求）。
IAC 起源為一家混合媒體/電子零售公司，距今已超過二十五年。此後，IAC（直接或透過前身公司）已轉型為一家領先的網際網路公司，透過開發、建立、收購及向股東分發多項業務，持續建立公司並進行機會性投資。

自 1990 年代末期起，我們收購了多家電子商務公司，包括 Ticketmaster Group（後更名為 Ticketmaster）、Hotel Reservations Network（後更名為 Hotels.com）、Expedia.com、Match.com、LendingTree（後更名為 Tree.com, Inc.）、TripAdvisor、HomeAdvisor 和 Ask Jeeves，以及 Interval International（後更名為 Interval Leisure Group, Inc.）。

2005 年，我們完成將我們的旅遊及旅遊相關業務與投資分拆為一家獨立上市公司，即 Expedia, Inc.（現稱為 Expedia Group, Inc.）。2008 年，我們分拆為五家獨立上市公司：IAC（當時為 IAC/InterActiveCorp）、HSN, Inc.（現為 Qurate Retail, Inc. 的一部分）、Interval Leisure Group, Inc.（現為 Marriott Vacations Worldwide Corporation 的一部分）、Ticketmaster（現稱為 Live Nation Entertainment, Inc.）和 Tree.com, Inc.（現稱為 LendingTree, Inc.）。此後，我們持續投資並收購電子商務公司，包括 About.com（後更名為 Dotdash）及美國與多個司法管轄區內的多家線上交友公司。

2017 年，我們完成將我們前 HomeAdvisor 財務報告分部的業務與 Angie's List, Inc. 的業務合併，成立一家新上市公司 ANGI Homeservices Inc.（現稱為 Angi Inc.），由我們控制。2018 年，透過此公司，我們收購 Handy Technologies, Inc.，這是一家美國領先的平台，用以連結尋求家庭服務的消費者與經過篩選的優質獨立家庭專業人士。
2020 年 2 月，我們收購 Care.com，這是一家線上平台，為家庭提供與兒童、年長父母、寵物及住宅照護者連線的服務，同時也為照護者提供與尋求照護服務的家庭連線的服務。2020 年 6 月，我們完成將我們的線上交友業務分拆為一家獨立上市公司，即 Match Group, Inc.

2021 年 5 月，我們完成將我們在 Vimeo 事業的全部股權分拆，自此 Vimeo, Inc.（原為 Vimeo Holdings, Inc.（"Vimeo"））成為一家獨立上市公司。2021 年 12 月，透過 Dotdash Media Inc.，我們完成對 Meredith Holdings Corp. 的收購，Meredith Holdings Corp. 是一家擁有出版品牌組合的公司。此後，我們將此合併後的實體，經營我們前 Dotdash 財務報告分部的業務及 Meredith Holdings Corp. 的業務，稱為 Dotdash Meredith Inc.（"Dotdash Meredith"）。
2022年11月，本公司完成出售Bluecrew，為專門提供彈性W-2工作的科技驅動式人力派遣平台。2024年2月15日，本公司完成出售Mosaic Group的資產，Mosaic Group為全球訂閱制行動應用程式的主要開發與供應商，交易金額約為160 百萬美元。
2025年3月31日，IAC透過特別股息（稱為「分拆」）完成Angi Inc.（「Angi」）的分拆，將IAC持有的所有Angi資本股票分發給其普通股與Class B普通股持有人。分拆後，IAC不再持有任何Angi資本股票，Angi成為獨立上市的公司。
最後，本公司持有MGM Resorts International（在賭博、旅館與休閒產業為領導者）以及Turo Inc.（車輛共享市場平台）的重要少數股權，並持有Vivian Health（一個有效連接醫療專業人員與就業機會的平台）的控制性股權。

IAC持有普通股，每股一票，以及Class B普通股，每股十票，且Class B普通股可按一比一轉換為普通股。截至本報告日，Barry Diller（IAC董事長與高階主管）、其配偶（Diane von Furstenberg）及其養子（Alexander von Furstenberg），共同持有（直接及透過特定信託）5,789,499股Class B普通股，代表所有Class B普通股的100%。加上截至本報告日，Diller先生持有的普通股（665,534股）、von Furstenberg先生持有的普通股（81,348股）、為Diller先生家族成員利益設立的信託（136,711股）以及家族基金（1,711股），這些持股合計約佔IAC總投票權的46%（根據2026年2月2日IAC普通股與Class B普通股的發行數量計算）。

根據IAC與Diller先生之間的修正後治理協議，只要Diller先生擔任IAC董事長與高階主管，且其有益擁有（根據1934年證券交易法第13d-3條規則定義）至少5,000,000股Class B普通股和/或其有財務利益的普通股（包括Diller先生直接或透過為其家族成員利益設立的信託持有的IAC證券），則在IAC總負債與EBITDA（根據治理協議定義）比率在連續十二個月期間達到或超過四比一時，Diller先生一般有權對協議中指定的有限事項進行同意。
由於Diller先生及其家族成員持有的IAC證券，截至本報告日，Diller先生及其家族成員 collectively 有權影響（受限於IAC組織章程與特拉華州法律）IAC董事會的組成以及需要股東批准的公司行動結果（例如合併、企業併購與資產處置等公司交易）。

paragraphs: IAC 現在由多項領先的產業類別業務組成，包括 People Inc. 和 Care.com 等，並持有 MGM Resorts International ("MGM") 和 Turo Inc. ("Turo") 的戰略性股權。
本文件中所稱的 "IAC"、"本公司"、"我們"、"我們的" 或 "我們的" 以及類似詞彙，均指 IAC Inc. 及其子公司（除非上下文另有要求）。

2025 年 3 月 31 日，IAC 透過特別股息（"分發"）完成 Angi Inc. ("Angi") 的分拆，將其持有的所有 Angi 資本股票分發給其普通股及 Class B 普通股持有人。分發後，IAC 不再持有任何 Angi 資本股票，且 Angi 成為一家獨立上市的公司。因此，自 2025 年 3 月 31 日以前的所有期間，Angi 的合併營運被列為 IAC 合併財務報表中的已終止營運。有關更多資訊，請參閱 "附註 17—已終止營運"，該附註為 "項目 8. 財務報表及補充資料" 中包含的財務報表附註。
除非另有說明或上下文另有要求，本年度報告中使用的某些詞彙，包括我們用以管理業務的主要營運指標，均定義如下。

•People Inc. - 美國最大的數位與印刷出版商之一，致力於為大眾提供由大眾所創造的內容，以帶來愉悅、教育、啟發與娛樂。每月超過 175 百萬人信任 People Inc.，以協助他們做出決定、採取行動並找到靈感。People Inc. 運作的 40 多個知名品牌包括 PEOPLE、Better Homes & Gardens、Verywell、Food & Wine、Travel + Leisure、Allrecipes、REAL SIMPLE、Investopedia 以及 Southern Living。People Inc. 有兩個運營分部：(i) 數位分部，包含其數位、行動與授權業務；以及 (ii) 印刷分部，包含其雜誌訂閱與報紙攤販業務。
2025 年 7 月 31 日，Dotdash Meredith Inc. 重新品牌為 "People Inc."，並在本報告中以此稱呼（除非上下文另有要求）。Dotdash Meredith Inc. 則仍為該公司的法定名稱；
•Care.com，為家庭連線照顧者（包括兒童、年長父母、寵物及住宅）以及照顧者連線尋求照顧服務的家庭的線上主要目的地。Care.com 的品牌包括 Care for Business（Care.com 給企業的服務）以及 HomePay；
•Search - 包括 Ask Media Group，一組提供一般搜尋服務與資訊的網站，以及 Desktop，我們的遺留桌面搜尋軟體業務，包括我們的業務對業務合作業務及我們直接對消費者下載的桌面應用程式剩餘安裝基礎；
如需更完整的本公司營運業務描述，請參閱「Item 1—Business」中所包含的「Description of IAC Businesses」。
•數位營收－包含廣告營收、成效行銷營收及授權與其他營收。
◦廣告營收－主要包含來自數位廣告及基於意圖的廣告投放能力（D/Cipher+）所產生的營收，該營收直接銷售給廣告主或透過廣告代理商及程序化廣告網路進行銷售。

◦成效行銷營收－主要包含透過聯屬商業、成效行銷服務及親近行銷渠道所產生的佣金收入。聯屬商業佣金收入係當People Inc.品牌內容引導消費者至商業夥伴網站並產生購買或交易時產生。成效行銷服務佣金收入係以每次點擊或每次行動成本為基礎產生。親近行銷計畫為一種安排，其中People Inc.同時作為People Inc.與第三方發行商的代理人，線上行銷與放置雜誌訂閱，當訂閱者姓名已提供給發行商時，即可獲得佣金收入。
◦授權與其他營收－主要包含透過品牌與內容授權及類似協議所產生的營收。品牌授權產生來自與零售商、服務提供者、發行商及製造商的長期商標授權協議的版稅收入。內容授權版稅則來自我們與Apple News+的關係，以及其它內容使用與分發關係，包括在大型語言模型及其他人工智慧（"AI"）相關活動中的使用。

headings: 警示聲明：有關未來資訊
與本公司業務、營運及股權相關的風險因素
旨在推動訪客至我們各項品牌與業務的行銷活動，可能無法成功或具成本效益。
廣告收入佔我們合併營業收入的重要部分。因此，我們對總體經濟事件與趨勢相當敏感，這些事件與趨勢可能不利於廣告支出水準。
我們的成功在部分程度上取決於我們數位業務能否成功擴大其出版品牌組合的受眾羣。
我們某些業務依賴與 Google 的合作安排。
本公司之成功在部分程度上取決於能否取得、收集及使用有關用戶及訂閱者之個人資料。
本公司之列印業務正經歷持續之營業收入下降，並面臨結構性、成本及運營挑戰，這些挑戰可能對本公司之營運結果產生不利影響。
本公司之退休金計畫義務可能增加。
本公司之成功在部分程度上取決於 Care.com 能否建立並維持與高品質且可信任之照顧者之關係。
本公司能及時與訂閱者及照顧者直接互動之能力，對本公司之成功至關重要。
迪勒先生及其家族成員能對 IAC 之董事會組成、需經股東批准之事項及 IAC 之運營施加重大影響。
與本公司流動性、負債及稀釋相關之風險因素
目前及未來之負債可能影響本公司運營業務之能力，此情況可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況及營運結果產生重大不利影響。
本公司可能無法產生足夠現金以償還所有債務。
變動利率債務及利率期貨使本公司面臨利率風險及交易對手風險。
本公司可能無法自由取得 People Inc. 及其子公司之現金。
與 IAC Securities 相關之風險
您可能因補償性股票獎勵而導致對 IAC 投資之稀釋。
IAC 普通股之市場價格及交易量可能波動，投資人可能面臨虧損。
若證券或產業分析師未持續發表研究報告或發表對 IAC 不利之研究報告，IAC 普通股之市場價格及交易量可能下跌。
IAC 與 Angi 可能無法實現分拆後預期的效益。
分拆後，IAC 作為一家規模較小、產業較不多元化的公司運作。
若分拆未能符合美國聯邦所得稅目的稅務無負擔交易，IAC、Angi 及其各自股東可能面臨重大不利後果。
IAC 或 Angi 可能無法履行其根據雙方之間特定協議所應負的義務。
我們的業務運作於高度競爭且不斷演進的產業中。
paragraphs: 本年度10-K表報表包含根據1995年私人證券訴訟改革法案所定義之「向前看聲明」。使用如「預期」、「估計」、「預期」、「計畫」及「相信」等詞彙，通常用以識別向前看聲明。這些向前看聲明包括，但不僅限於：IAC未來之財務表現、IAC之業務前景與策略、IAC所從事產業之預期趨勢與前景及其他類似事項。這些向前看聲明係根據IAC管理階層於本年度報表日對未來事件之預期與假設，而這些預期與假設本身 inherently 受到不確定性、風險與情勢變動之影響，而這些變動難以預測。
實際結果可能與這些向前看聲明所載內容有重大差異，原因可能包括，但不僅限於下列風險因素。其他未知或無法預測之因素，也可能隨時影響IAC之業務、財務狀況與營運結果。根據這些風險與不確定性，本年度報表所討論之向前看聲明可能無法準確實現。因此，您不應過度依賴這些向前看聲明，這些聲明僅反映IAC管理階層於本年度報表日之觀點。IAC不承諾更新這些向前看聲明。
本公司業務受多種風險與不確定性影響，包括本項目1A所敘述之風險。這些風險包括，但不僅限於以下事項：
•我們依賴搜尋引擎來吸引用戶至我們各項資產。
•旨在增加訪客至我們各項品牌與業務之行銷活動可能無法成功或成本效益不高。
•人工智能及其他數位科技之進步正在改變人們存取與消費資訊的方式。
